Why go: a private longtail to Pig Island

A private longtail is the best-value private boat on Koh Samui's south coast. For 5,950 THB per boat you get a traditional wooden longtail and its captain for 5–6 hours, for up to 8 guests. Split four ways that is about 1,490 THB each, close to the price of a seat on the shared speedboat, but the boat, the timing and the stops are yours. Eight guests pay the same as two.

The route covers the two islands every Pig Island trip visits, at your pace. From Thong Krut pier the longtail takes 20–30 minutes to reach the islands. Koh Tan has a shallow reef close to the beach, the best easy snorkelling in the area, and you can stay as long as you like. Koh Madsum (Pig Island) has a white-sand beach where the island's pigs wander between the trees and the shallows, with shade and a beach restaurant. You tell the captain the order and how long to stay at each stop.

Timing is the big advantage. Start in the morning to reach Koh Madsum before most shared tours, when the water is usually calmest and the light is good for snorkelling. Or start in the afternoon for quieter beaches and the sunset on the way back. Compared with the private speedboat (11,950 THB, up to 10 guests), the longtail costs half as much and is slower, but on a crossing this short the difference is minutes, not hours.

Suggested timing

  • Morning start: Koh Madsum first, before the shared boats arrive, then Koh Tan for snorkelling and lunch at a beach restaurant. Back in the early afternoon.
  • Afternoon start: Koh Tan for a snorkel while the sun is high, then Koh Madsum in the late light, with sunset on the crossing home.
  • Add a third island: to include quiet Koh Rap, book the three-islands private boat (8,450 THB per boat).

Who this tour is for

  • Families and small groups of up to 8, especially with young children who need their own pace.
  • Couples who want Pig Island without a crowd.
  • Groups of four or more, for whom private works out at about the shared price.
  • Anyone who prefers a slow, traditional boat to a speedboat.

Who should choose another tour

  • More than 8 guests: the private speedboat takes up to 10, or ask us about two boats.
  • One or two people on a budget: the shared speedboat tour (1,450 THB) or longtail tour (1,750 THB with lunch).
  • Want a dry, fast ride or extra islands: the private speedboat.
  • Want all-inclusive with lunch arranged: the small-group longtail.

What to bring

  • A picnic and drinks if you don't plan to eat at a beach restaurant (take all rubbish home).
  • Cash in small notes for the Koh Madsum island fee (about 50 THB per person) and food or drinks on the islands.
  • Reef-safe sunscreen, hats, sunglasses and a long-sleeved layer: there is little shade on a longtail.
  • Swimwear, towels and a change of clothes.
  • A dry bag for phones: longtails can splash.
  • Water shoes for rocky shallows, and fins if you want them.

Good to know

  • Sea by month: January to September is best, February to April calmest. October to December is the rainy season: light rain doesn't stop the boat, but strong wind can. The captain has the final say on safety; if we cancel for weather, you choose a full refund or a new date.
  • Shade and spray: longtails have limited shade and take spray in choppy water. Calm days usually stay mostly dry.
  • Toddlers: the water between Thong Krut and the islands is shallow and sheltered, and adult and child life jackets are on board. Children wear them at all times on the boat. Tell us children's ages when you book so the right sizes are ready.
  • Mobility: longtails land on the beach, so expect to step into knee-deep water.
  • Daylight: trips run in daylight and in safe sea conditions.
  • The pigs: watch, photograph and let them come to you; don't chase, lift or feed them junk food.
  • Drones: registered drones only (CAAT and NBTC); keep clear of the animals and other visitors.

Pickup and meeting point

Most private guests meet the boat at Thong Krut pier on the south-west coast, and we send the exact location on WhatsApp. Hotel transfers can be added on request. They cover the main areas of Koh Samui (Chaweng, Lamai, Bophut, Maenam, Choeng Mon, Bang Rak and Plai Laem). Thong Krut is about 45–60 minutes by road from Chaweng and 30–40 minutes from Lamai. Tell us your preferred start time when you book.
